settings.diag.intro: Records what the app receives from the radio into a file you can send to the maintainer. Use it when something is wrong and a screenshot cannot show why — a missing repeater badge, messages that never arrive.
settings.diag.privacy: The capture contains the text of every message received while it runs, along with contact names and public keys. Only send it to someone you trust.
settings.diag.reproduce_hint: Now reproduce the problem — send the message that misbehaves, then come back here and stop the recording.
settings.diag.sharing_hint: Optional. With a token from the maintainer a capture can be uploaded straight from here; without one, download it and send it yourself.
settings.diag.upload_token_ph: paste the token you were given
